༄༅/ /sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /

skye med dbyings kyi yum chen ma/ /phyag mtshan mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bri/ /mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ byin rlabs khyad par 'jug pa dang*/ rtags kyi spyod pa rgya chen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsgrub par bya'o/ / de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni gnas drung ngam/ gnyan khrod dam/ dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ dus zla ba gcig dang zhag bdun bsgrub par bya ste/ gnas der phyag dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ bla re yol ba la sogs pa btags la/ maṇḍal mda' gang gru bzhi bya/ de la padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa bri/ dbus su mthing ga mu khyud dkar po bya/ mtshams thams cad phyogs tshon bya/ de'i dbus dang 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa bri/ me tog tshom bu bkod do/ /dbus su mañdzi'i steng du zangs gzhongs nas kyis bkang ba'i steng thod pa chang gis bkang ba bzhag /de'i nang du bdud rtsi'i ril bu bcug /de'i khar me long la sin dhu ra byug la/ de la a ma jo mo'i sku khros ma nag mo'i cha lugs su bris la bzhag /mchod pa rnam pa lnga 'bul/ gtor ma lnga bshams/ tshogs ji tsam 'byor ba bsham/ rnga dang dung dang*/ ḍā ma ru la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag rnams bsham mo/ / dngos gzhi la gsum/ lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba dang*/ thun mtshams su mchod pa 'bul ba'o/ /dang po lha sgom pa ni/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bya/ de nas rang gi snying gar yi ge a sngon po zhig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros ste spyi bo nas yar la song bas bar snang dang me long gi nang du yum chen mo a ma jo mo ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam du bsgom/ nyi zla'i steng na sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag gnyis pa can la zhal gcig yin dgos sam dpyad zhi ma khro/ spyan gsum pa skra grol ba'i spyi bo na phag zhal thon pa/

sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ phyag g.yas cang te'u/ ting ting shag btags pa/ g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ kha ṭwām̐ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i rting pa bha ga la gtad pa/ g.yon brkyang ba snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'ja' tshon ltar bsgom/ me long nang du'ang de bzhin du bsgom/ de'i phyogs bzhi na/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser/ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro dmar/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun par bsgom/ de la 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sha za'i mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro rang rang gi 'khor 'bum dang bcas pas bskor bar bsgom/ mkha' 'gro lnga la rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bya/ mkha' 'gro lnga rang rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar baṃ dgod/ de thams cad kyi tha mar ha ri ni sas bskor bar bsgom/ de'i tha mar snying po 'bru bcu gsum gyis bskor bar bsgom/ sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ baṃ ghu ru ha ri ni sa siddhi hūṃ/ zhes pa ni snying po dam pa yin pas rig pa'i rtsal bskyed la zla ba gcig dang zhag bdun du bzla/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ mkha' 'gro lnga dang me long gi mkha' 'gro la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs thams cad tshur 'dus/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs par bsgoms/ rdzogs rim sgom pa'i dus su bar snang gi lha dang me long gi lha rang la bstim ste/ sems rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du bzhag go / thun mtshams su mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas/ tshogs bdud rtsi rnam gsum du byin gyis brlabs la rol/ mchod pa nam mkha' lha yis gang ba la phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du byas la/

nang bcud kyi longs spyod 'dod yon lnga'i tshogs snang srid gzhir bzhengs su 'bul lo/ /rang gi mig las gzugs kyi rdo rje me tog ma/ rna ba las sgra'i rdo rje sil snyan ma/ sna las dri'i rdo rje bdug spos ma/ lce las ro'i rdo rje zhal zas ma/ lus las reg bya'i rdo rje dri chab ma/ yid las chos kyi rdo rje bde chen ma spros la oṃ ma hā ghu ru dhe ba ṭākki ni/ puṣpe/ dhuṣpe sogs btags la mos gus kyis ngar bskyed la cang te'u bkrol/ me tog bdug spos mar me dang*/ /dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang*/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ces pas 'bul lo/ /gtor ma btang ba ni rgyan rab sha dang sha chen/ nya sha /'bri mar/ khur ba/ tha ma rgog pa/ la phug sogs la/ khrag gam chang gis bran la bdud rtsi rnam pa gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ma hā ghu ru dhe ba ṭākki la bha ling btags la 'bul lo/ khams gsum ma lus zhing khams na/ /sku gsum 'khor 'das thugs rje'i mgron/ /stong gsum bdud rtsis bkang ba'i rdzas/ /gtor ma 'don yon lnga ru bsngo/ /zhes 'bul lo/ /me mchod bya ba ni/ manḍal mda' gang gru bzhi la/ padma dmar po 'dab brgyad bris la/ shing brtseg me sbar ba'i nang du bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro bsgoms la/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin chen lnga/ dar zab/ me tog /bza' btung*/ tshogs phud/ gtor ma/ phye mar khur ba la sogs pa me nang du 'bul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ghu ru dhe ba ṭākki ni baṃ ha ri ni sa dzwa la raṃ ag ne pū dza hūṃ/ ye shes me yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /'dod yon sreg rdzas me mchod 'bul/ /phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig shintiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas gyur cig puṣtiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi nor zas gsum 'dus gyur cig wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

dgra bgegs phung zhing brlag gyur cig ma ra ya rbad/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag skye med dbyings kyi yum/ /'gags med rtsa bral sems nyid don gyi yum/ /mtha' dbus med pa mtha' bral stong pa'i yum/ /yum chen chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i skur sprul ma/ /skyon gyis ma gos padma'i skur sprul ma/ /'dod yon sgrub pa las kyi skur sprul ma/ /yum chen sku lnga lhun grub phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phaṭa bya'o// mjug gi bya ba ni/ me long nang du nam mkha' la bsgom pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga po bstims la me long chang gis bkrus la btung*/ me long snying gar gtugs te lha lnga snying la bstim par bsgom/ de nas gsang spyod zhag bdun du bskyang ba ni/ bdag nyid khros ma nag mor bsgom/ spyi bor dkon mchog gsum/ mgrin par bla ma/ snying gar yi dam/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ lte bar las kyi mkha' 'gro bsgom/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro yin snyam pas rig pa ngar bskyed la gcer bur phyung*/ cang te'u bkrol rgyug cing mchong bar bya'o/ /zas su dri chen dri chu mi sha khyi sha la sogs pa gang rnyed pa gtsang rtsog med par gang rnyed par bza' bar rgyug /'khrab pa dang bro bya gar byed/ rtog med smyon pa'i tshul gyis snying la ci dran bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas lus la byin rlab zhugs/ bde drod 'bar te/ sa chu me rlung g.yang la sogs pa la mchong nus/ mchongs kyang nye zho mi yong*/ dug bza'/ mtshon la rtsed mo byed/ gyad la brdung nus pa la sogs pa gang la'ang mi phod pa med pa tsham tshom med par nus pa 'byung*/ ngag tu glu dang dbyangs blang ngo*/ /'o dod 'bod pa/ ngu 'bod pa sna tshogs bya ste/ de ltar byas pas ngag la nus pa zhugs te/ ci smras kyang kun la phan pa/ bden par 'dzin pa/ nus pa mthu dang ldan pa 'byung ngo*/ /yid la dga' mi dga' bde mi bde ci dran yang*/

gtad med bden med du bsgoms pas nang du bde stong*/ gsal stong*/ snang stong*/ snying rje'i nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes nas/ phyi ru ngo tsha ba dang ya nga ba dang bag tsha ba med pa 'byung*/ nang du snang ba bden zhen log nas chags sdang dang chos brgyad bde sdug thams cad rang zhi rang dag rang la rang grol tu 'gro/ 'khor 'das khyad med/ dgra gnyen khyad med/ gser dang bong ba khyad med pa 'byung ste/ de tsa na rtogs pa shar/ grub pa thob/ 'khor 'das rus pa shan phyed/ rang don tshar/ gzhan don byed ran pa'i tshad yin no/ / ༈ e ma hoḥ gtad med sems kyi bzhag sa de/ /chos nyid lags so ma yengs skyong*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub de/ /bsgrubs pas 'byung gi snying po zlos/ /re dogs med pa'i nyams len de/ /bzhag pas grol gyis khres se zhog /'jur bus bcing pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /klod na grol gyis rang sar zhog /rang sems skye med spros bral de/ /bsgom du med de goms su chugs/ /gdams ngag ston pa'i bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas lags so gsol ba thob/ /nga la 'gro 'ong mi lta ste/ /nga bsgoms gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ /yi ge bcu gsum bzlas pa dang*/ /stong nyid snying rje sgom pa la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*/ /dbyings kyi yum chen nga nyid dang*/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i tshogs/ /zhe nas byin gyis mi rlobs re/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis mi ster re/ /ci bsam dgos 'dod mi 'byung re/ /don chen 'grub bo ma yi bu/ /rang nyid 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /ma yi thugs dang dbyer med par/ /chos nyid ngang du phyad kyis 'gro /dga' bar sgoms la nyams su longs/ /bka' drin che soms dga' bar sgoms/ /skyid par soms la gsol ba thob/ /nga dang 'bral med sgrub pa'i thabs/ /snying po bcu gsum gsung gis sgrubs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub kyi rtsa ba/ 'chugs med gnad kyi zhal gdams bka' rgya can sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed rdzogs so//

//athi+-i/ mkhas grub dri med pa'i gcod spul sku padma gling pa'i gsung las lung thob pa'o/ /maṅga lam/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed/ - PAGE 30 -- PAGE 31 -- PAGE 26 -
